title: O'Reilly: Brown inventions handed to consortium

tellings.quote: He says that a couple of other Brown inventions were handed over to other entities and this consortium seems to have something to do with it.

plain: Some inventions by Townsend Brown, a scientist said to have worked on flying-saucer-like technology, are said to have been handed over to other organizations, with an unnamed consortium seeming to be part of it. Michels relays this in his documentary about Brown, passing on what a man named O'Reilly says and naming a writer called Paul Schatzkin in the same account. If true, part of Brown's work would have quietly gone into private hands.
